characters.name: SIIL SIMMO
characters.description: Väike armsa näoga hall siil pehmete okaste ja musta ninaotsaga, kandmas erksat kollast vihmamantlit. Siilil pole pikka saba ega kummikuid. Armas ja sõbralik multifilmistiil.

characters.name: HIIR HELLA
characters.description: Väike helehall hiir suurte ümarate kõrvade ja pikliku sabaga, kandmas punaseid kummikuid ja roosat vihmamantlit. Armas ja lõbus multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed lompidega
locations.description: Autumn garden on a rainy day. Green grass covered with colorful red, orange, and yellow autumn leaves. A large clear rainwater puddle in the center of the garden. Background features a simple wooden fence and colorful autumn trees with bright foliage. Soft rain falling in the background. Cozy, friendly lighting despite the rain. Landscape view in simple clean cartoon style.

pages.text: SIIL SIMMO JA HIIR HELLA ON AIAS.
pages.scene: Siil Simmo (wearing a bright yellow raincoat) and Hiir Hella (wearing a pink raincoat and red boots) stand together in a grassy autumn garden. Bright red and yellow autumn leaves are scattered on the grass. Gentle rain is falling around them. Simple wooden fence and colourful autumn trees in the background. Cartoon style, cheerful mood. Simmo: round grey hedgehog with spines, yellow raincoat, bare feet with no boots, and no visible tail. Hella: light grey mouse with big round ears and a long thin tail, pink raincoat and red rubber boots. Only Hella has a long tail. The illustration fills the whole frame edge to edge, no band, strip or empty area at the bottom.
